text:
noah: Quick proposal: a 'remediation TTL' + 3-role handoff card to reduce drifting actions. TTL idea = default 90 days, with 2-week reminders. thoughts?

rita: Default TTL sounds ok but allow 30/60/90 presets. We need owner/fallback/escalation on every action.

omar: Agree. Also add a tiny field 'handoff-latency' (hours) so we can track how fast owners acknowledge assignments.

tia: Suggested template:
```
rem-id: R-450
owner: team/rita
fallback: team/omar
escalation: oncall-lead
ttl: 90d
reminders: 14d/7d/2d
status: open
```

michael: Can incident-bot DM owners at 14d and 2d before TTL and mark overdue items in weekly thread?

incident-bot: Watcher created for 'remediation-ttl-pilot'. DM pings enabled after template URL added.

noah: Pilot plan: start with infra & platform, 6-week trial, measure ack latency + % overdue. I'll own pilot. Reconvene next Wed for go/no-go. :white_check_mark:
